 Order

This is fourth bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.323/2023 dated 26.05.2023 registered at Police Station Patan, District Jabalpur for the offences punishable under Sections 304B, 498A, 34 of IPC and Sections 3, 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act .
2. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
The applicant is in jail since 27.06.2023 and the trial of the case will take considerable time to conclude.
The applicant is permanent resident of the district and there is no likelihood of her absconding or tampering with prosecution evidence.
She is ready to deposit adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed upon her by the Court.
On these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant may also be released on bail.
3. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application.

sentences.text: 4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
5 . This is the fourth bail application filed by the applicant, who is the mother-in-law of deceased and facing trial for the offence of Section 304B of IPC etc.

Ealier three applications were dismissed on merits under M.Cr.C.
No.31090/2023, 37391/2023 and 54093/2023.

6. This application has been argued on the ground that parents and brother namely Ganesh Choudhary of deceased have been examined before the trial Court and they have not supported the prosecution story.
Case diary reveals that one more brother of deceased namely Gajendra Choudhary was examined during police investigation and his statements have not yet been recorded before the Court.

7. Despite the non-examination of Gajendra Choudhary in Court and having considered the statements of other near relatives of deceased, this Court finds it fit to release the applicant on bail,
therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, this repeat bail application is allowed.

8. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for her appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.

9. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
10.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.

(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE pnm Laxmi Bai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45626348/
